extensionDescription.message: Super-drag links and images, search dragged text, and quickly restore recently closed tabs.

dragTextSearchLabel.message: Search dragged text with the default search engine (asks permission when first enabled)

openInBackgroundLabel.message: Open dragged content in background tabs

privacyHint.message: Links, images, and tab restore stay local. Text search is sent to Firefox's default search engine only after you grant permission.
